resources.string: Kaala Kolam (காலக்கோலம்): a bilingual, fully offline app for learning weather and climate from elders and from science. Department of Zoology, GASC, Nagercoil.
This device has no Tamil text-to-speech voice installed, so read-aloud cannot speak Tamil. Open the text-to-speech settings and install the Tamil voice data.
Department of Zoology, GASC, Nagercoil / Created by R. Ramesh
Works fully offline, collects no data. Your interviews, predictions and progress stay on this device only.

Educational use only. This is not an official warning service. For weather warnings follow the India Meteorological Department (IMD) and your State Disaster Management Authority. Please check the emergency numbers for your own district.
